## Repository-Wide Coding Rules

Before investigating, proposing, or changing this repository, read and follow
the root `AGENTS.md` and applicable nested instructions. Its requirements cover
human maintainability, measured performance, pre-change impact/risk assessment,
honest objective confidence on a 0–100% scale, agent-friendly feature design,
existing approvals, and final verification/handoff. Existing rules below or
above this reference remain in force; this reference does not waive them.
